name: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd
title: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd - 544307 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 SSSG 13.2% and FY26 revenue INR 12,906 cr (+20.4%), but management flagged input inflation from May and promotions lifted to clear stock, so gross margin pressure is the watch item.

triggers.label: Q4 SSSG 13.2%
triggers.quote: Our same -store sales growth for quarter 4 was 13.2%.

triggers.label: Fabric prices up 10-11%
triggers.quote: the fabric prices are goin g up at about 10% to 11%

triggers.label: Store expansion 105 added, 795 total
triggers.quote: We opened 25 stores during quarter 4 and 105 stores during the full year.

triggers.label: Working capital held at FY26 level
triggers.quote: this is by and large same as last year. So that's the level at which we would like to operate.

guidance.quote: We will not slow down our expansion at all

guidance.metric: Discount vs market leader private brands
guidance.quote: we will ensure that the discount will at least be 40%

red_flags.label: Gross margin compression in Q4 from promotions
Input inflation from crude-linked materials
red_flags.quote: we are seeing an inflation in the input prices

evasions.quote: I will have to rely on my Board, because I cannot express any view independent of the Board
it's very difficult to speculate on the macro
